rows.abstract: Declares that --- "SECTION   1. -  Priority rights - Priority water rights for use in irrigation projects, water impounding and  similar constructions shall be granted to the Province, City, Municipality or Barangay where the body of  fresh water/creeks, ponds,  lakes, rivers are located." Declares, further, that adjoining areas shall be entitled  to USE  THE EXCESS   WATER for irrigation, etc. * * *
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 1993-08-17

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ESTABLISH A NEW SYSTEM OF PERSONNEL MANAGEMENT FOR MILITARY PERSONNEL OF THE ACTIVE FORCE OF THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "AFP Personnel Management Act of 1992" Defines  terms for purposes of  this  Act; highlights significant provisions on: (1) Composition, strength  and grade distribution of  the  AFP active force; (2) Appointment of regular officers, PMA cadets andreserve officers; (3) Professional development, utiliza- tion and promotion of officers; (4) Efficiency and separation board; and     (5) Retirement and separation benefits.
